dataset.name: citation-entailment-challenge-v1
dataset.license: synthetic, CC0 — hand-written examples, no external corpus
dataset.description: Adversarial claim/evidence panel for the entailment assessor, deliberately harder than citation-entailment-v1. Every item is designed so a lexical-overlap assessor is misled: the passage shares the claim's vocabulary but a semantic reader must reject or invert the naive match. Categories: `numeric_conflict` (the passage reports the opposite direction or an incompatible magnitude with no explicit negation cue), `species_mismatch` (evidence is in a different organism/model than the claim asserts), `temporal_mismatch` (evidence is about a different time window or endpoint), `topic_mention_only` (the passage mentions every keyword but never asserts the claimed relationship), `retracted` (the only supporting passage is a retracted study and must not count as support), `paraphrase_support` (an entailing passage restates the claim with little shared vocabulary), and `paraphrase_contradiction` (a contradicting passage with no lexicon negation marker). Expected labels use supports/contradicts/insufficient. A retracted or unavailable source yields insufficient because no admissible passage supports the claim. Synthetic and legally shareable; NOT Google's private set. Human audit and threshold selection remain an external gap (no annotator panel).

report.external_gap: Human-audited representative sample and threshold calibration not performed (no annotator panel); synthetic dataset only. Retraction handling is upstream of this assessor (retracted sources are quarantined before grounding), so a retracted-passage item scored here isolates only the assessor, not the full pipeline.

dataset.name: historical_false_contradiction_controls
dataset.purpose: Existing committed regression examples; only non-contradiction is adjudicated. No private production documents accessed.

items.claim: Donepezil, at clinically achievable human brain free concentrations of 10-30 nM, occupies sigma-1R (Ki ~14 nM) at the ER-mitochondria contact site.
passages: The same ligand is ineffective at blocking wild-type NaVs and does not disrupt action potential signals in neuronal cells or brain tissue at working concentrations.

items.claim: GBM cells engage compensatory stress-response programs (autophagy-glycolysis crosstalk) to survive metabolic stress.
passages: These findings identify a novel and complex compensatory interplay between glycolysis, autophagy, and senescence that helps maintain stemness in heterogeneous GBM tumor subpopulations.

items.claim: Together, these actions reduce collagen synthesis and α-SMA expression, attenuating the fibrotic phenotype.
passages: Wnt inhibition and the fibrotic phenotype in cardiac fibroblasts. Treatment with LGK-974 significantly reduced both α-SMA and collagen type I expression, whereas ETC-159 selectively decreased collagen type I. Body weight did not differ between groups.

items.claim: Metformin activates AMPK in human cardiac fibroblasts, leading to inhibitory phosphorylation of Smad3 (Ser203/207) and suppression of HIF-1α-mediated glycolysis, thereby blocking TGF-β-induced myofibroblast transition and collagen deposition.
passages: Pirfenidone attenuates lung fibrotic fibroblast responses to transforming growth factor-β1. Furthermore, pirfenidone attenuated TGF-β1- and CTHRC1-induced fibroblast activity, upregulation of bone morphogenic protein-4(BMP-4)/Gremlin1, and downregulation of α-smooth muscle actin, fibronectin, and FHL2, similar to that observed post-CTHRC1 inhibition. Myofibroblast transition and collagen deposition were assessed in human cardiac fibroblasts after TGF-β1 stimulation. AMPK phosphorylation, Smad3 phosphorylation and glycolysis were measured; HIF-1α protein was quantified. Body weight did not differ between groups.

items.claim: Metformin enters cardiac fibroblasts and activates AMPK via LKB1.
passages: AMPK activation in fibroblasts under nutrient stress. We found that glucose starvation transiently activates AMPK, whereas changes in glucagon and insulin levels had no impact on AMPK. Body weight did not differ between groups.

dataset.name: prospective_partial_support_scope_controls
dataset.purpose: Prospective synthetic non-regression controls for the primary prompt correction; not a blind held-out benchmark or expert-adjudicated scientific truth. Frozen before any live call on these inputs. Existing 30-item challenge and historical controls remain unchanged.
dataset.acceptance: Every control must receive an allowed label in each fresh candidate trial, with located quotes for supports/partial/contradicts, same frozen model and zero-cost routing. Preserve baseline outcomes; improvement remains measured on the existing challenge.

items.claim: In adult human hepatocytes, compound R reduces lipid accumulation and restores insulin sensitivity after seven days.
passages: In adult human hepatocytes, compound R reduced lipid accumulation after seven days; insulin sensitivity was not measured.

items.claim: Treatment S completely stops migration of human fibroblasts during a 24-hour assay.
passages: Treatment S reduced migration of human fibroblasts during a 24-hour assay; the magnitude of reduction was not reported.

items.claim: Compound R can reduce lipid accumulation in cultured cells.
passages: Compound R reduced lipid accumulation in cultured rat hepatocytes.

items.claim: Treatment S reduces migration of adult human fibroblasts after 24 hours.
passages: Adult human fibroblasts migrated less after 24 hours of treatment S.

items.claim: Intervention L lowers blood pressure in adults with chronic kidney disease.
passages: Intervention L lowered blood pressure in healthy adults; people with chronic kidney disease were excluded.

items.claim: Compound R reduces lipid accumulation in primary human hepatocytes.
passages: Compound R reduced lipid accumulation in rat hepatocytes; no human hepatocytes were tested.

items.claim: Intervention L reduces stroke incidence over two years in hypertensive adults.
passages: In hypertensive adults followed for two years, intervention L lowered systolic blood pressure; stroke incidence was not measured.

items.claim: Treatment S suppresses fibroblast migration for fourteen days.
passages: Treatment S suppressed fibroblast migration at six hours; no later measurements were collected.

items.claim: Compound R reduces lipid accumulation at 1 micromolar in human hepatocytes.
passages: Compound R reduced lipid accumulation in human hepatocytes at 100 micromolar; 1 micromolar was not tested.

items.claim: Treatment S increases migration of adult human fibroblasts after 24 hours.
passages: Treatment S did not increase migration of adult human fibroblasts after 24 hours; it decreased migration.
